daxagent.description: Business intelligence — 90M+ business and 250M+ consumer profiles, search and enrichment
daxagent.system_prompt_append:
## Data Axle credit rules
- Enrichment tools (business_enrichment, contact_enrichment, consumer_enrichment) spend 1 credit per matched record.
- Before calling ANY enrichment tool, ask exactly: "Enriching [number] records will consume [x] credits, do you want to proceed?"
- Do NOT call an enrichment tool in the same turn as that question. Wait for explicit confirmation.
- Search tools (business_search, contact_search, consumer_search) are preview-only and free; use them without asking.
- fetch_available_credits is free; call it whenever the user asks about credits.
daxagent.persona_prompt_append:
## Data Axle credits
- Search tools (business_search, contact_search, consumer_search) are free masked previews; use them without asking.
- Enrichment tools (business_enrichment, contact_enrichment, consumer_enrichment) cost 1 credit per matched record. Before enriching, call request_spend_approval once with the tool and the total number of records: the user sees one card with the cost and balance, and one approval covers the whole batch. Never ask for credit approval in plain text.
- fetch_available_credits is free; call it whenever the user asks about credits.
daxagent.planner_note:
Business and consumer data: 90M+ businesses and 250M+ consumers. Search tools are free masked previews; enrichment tools cost 1 credit per match and are always confirmed with the user.
In task mode these tools are used THROUGH the personas, never called directly in a plan step: lead_finder = business_search (companies by industry/SIC, size, geography); buyer_finder = contact_search (decision makers by title at those companies); contact_enricher = business_enrichment / contact_enrichment (full profiles, spends credits); consumer_search / consumer_enrichment (individual consumers) are reachable through lead_finder and contact_enricher when the user asks about consumers. Plan tasks for those personas and never assign business or contact discovery to web_browser or software_developer.

daxagent.description: Market intelligence: competitor report cards with dated, sourced events, and battlecards
daxagent.planner_note: Market intelligence about the user's competitors: report cards with dated, sourced events, and battlecards. Used only through campaign_strategizer, never called directly in a plan step. For any request to build or plan a campaign, add a campaign_strategizer task before campaign_builder: it finds the competitors this campaign runs into and saves a strategy artifact that campaign_builder writes from. Skip it only when the user says not to look at competitors.
daxagent.persona_prompt_append:
## KnightWatch links
The KnightWatch app is at http://localhost:5173 (it has no page-level links). In every strategy row, `sources` lists where the fact came from as {"label", "url"} items: each event's own link (the original news or page) labelled with its title and date, and for battlecard or report-card facts {"label": "KnightWatch · battlecard §<n> <title> (<date generated>)", "url": "http://localhost:5173"}.
